AgentCompletionConfig.description: Per-completion LLM knobs for an agent run

model.description: Semantic model preset (defaults to BALANCED when omitted)

AgentInput.description: A single input item submitted to the agent (role + text content)

content.description: Plain text content of the item

CreateAgentRequest.description: Request to schedule a new agent run

message.description: Stateful mode: the new user message for this turn. Prior turns are loaded server-side from `conversationId`. Mutually exclusive with `messages`.
message.example: Summarize the attached report and list the main risks.

files.description: Files the agent can read from

config.description: Optional job launch behaviour for input files

output_model_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema constraining the agent's final answer to a structured object. Free-form: any valid JSON Schema is accepted

completion_config.description: Per-completion LLM knobs (model preset, temperature, max tokens)

max_iterations.description: Hard cap on the number of agent-loop iterations

conversation_id.description: Stateful only: continue an existing server session. Omit to start a new conversation. Must not be set for stateless runs.

ItemReference.description: Reference to an item. Use trailing slash for folders (e.g., 'folder/' or 'path/to/folder/')

nextCursor.description: Cursor for next page, null if no more pages
